heroDescription: I'm a Full Stack developer passionate about technology, problem-solving, and building digital experiences that genuinely make a difference.

paragraphs: My programming journey started with curiosity about how the applications we use every day actually work under the hood.
Over time, that curiosity turned into passion. I started studying different technologies, building projects, and constantly looking for better ways to solve problems.
Today I work mainly with Full Stack development, aiming to combine a good user experience with organized, secure, and scalable code.
